# overlay place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayPlace`](gmeow-overlayPlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayPlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The place over which this regulatory overlay applies. Functional: an overlay concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity). The place carries the geographic geometry; the overlay carries the regulation and temporal scope.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single place a regulatory overlay applies over; functional, constitutive of identity.

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying the geometry here (the place carries it) and avoid multiple places per overlay.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:overlayPlace`](gmeow-overlayPlace.md); the place holds the geometry, the overlay holds the regulation and temporal scope.
